verdict.rationale: Vanta's Trust Center is documented as showing 'live controls' alongside docs in a branded portal. That supports the control-status part of the story: it updates from the platform rather than by hand. The evidence does not show subprocessor lists syncing automatically or documents renewing on their own inside the Trust Center. Missing for 10: automatic subprocessor list updates, automated document renewal/expiry refresh, detailed docs on how live controls sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the trust center stays current on its own — subprocessor lists, document renewals, and control status update from the platform, not by hand

citations.quote: Trust Center puts your docs, live controls, and AI-powered answers in one branded portal
